prompt: A photorealistic wide frame of the community hall after everyone has gone, taken from a lens mounted high above the stage and looking down the length of the room, so the two figures are small. Jenny stands on the left of the frame stacking folding chairs against a breeze-block wall, shoulders dropped, brows pulled together, eyelids heavy and her eyes aimed at the floor in front of her. Brandon stands on the right of the frame a few metres away with his hands open at his sides, brows tilted up in the middle, lips pressed and pulled slightly down, his eyes aimed at Jenny; a small warm patch of light glows at his jeans pocket. The floor is scuffed pale lino scattered with paper cups, and the only light is a few remaining ceiling tubes and a dull orange streetlight leaking through a high window. The colour is washed out and muddy, with night-mode grain and compression blocks in the dark corners. Nothing in frame has any writing. Thanks.
